topic: How do MPLS and IPsec VPNs differ in mitigating congestion for real-time QoS in multi-telectric utility backbones?
consensus_response: MPLS's LSP-based routing introduces path selection overhead, leading to latency under heavy traffic. This is exacerbated by shared infrastructure, where interference from other traffic can significantly degrade performance. IPsec VPNs prioritize security through encryption but may introduce latency due to dedicated links and shared infrastructure.  Both technologies face limitations in high-traffic scenarios due to shared infrastructure.
